subheadline: Have an upcoming product, redesign, or engineering challenge? Tell me about your goals and timeline below, or connect directly through WhatsApp.

principles.title: Fast, transparent updates
principles.description: Weekly video summaries and collaborative Figma files.

principles.title: Full code & design ownership
principles.description: Complete source code and vector assets handed over upon completion.

principles.title: Post-launch support
principles.description: 30 days of warranty and bug fixing included in all full contracts.

process_steps.title: Discovery & Brief
process_steps.description: We review your goals, scope, and target audience within 24 hours of receiving your inquiry.

process_steps.title: Strategy & Alignment
process_steps.description: A focused 20-minute call to align on technical feasibility, design direction, and deliverable milestones.

process_steps.title: Execution & Launch
process_steps.description: Structured sprints with transparent Figma files, staging previews, and guaranteed on-time delivery.

faqs.question: How quickly will you reply to my message?
faqs.answer: I reply to all inquiries within 24 business hours. If you need immediate assistance or have an urgent timeline, contacting me directly via WhatsApp is recommended.

faqs.question: What information should I have ready before reaching out?
faqs.answer: A high-level description of what you are building, your target timeline, and an estimated budget range are great starting points. If you already have wireframes, design references, or PRDs, feel free to mention them.

faqs.question: How are project payments structured?
faqs.answer: Typical engagements are milestone-based: 50% upfront to reserve the sprint, and 50% upon final delivery and client approval. For larger full-stack developments, we can establish three milestone installments.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients across different timezones?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. I work with clients across the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia. Communication is maintained through scheduled async updates, Slack/WhatsApp channels, and convenient video check-ins.
